sn45.30:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Uttiyo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || la || || 4. Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Uttiyo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn45.30:1.3: Idha mayham bhante rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn45.30:1.5: katame nu kho pañca kāmaguṇā Bhagavatā ti || || 5.
sn45.30:1.7: pañcime kho Uttiya kāmaguṇā vuttā mayā || ||
sn45.30:1.9: cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā ||
sn45.30:1.13: kāyaviññeyyā phoṭṭhabbā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn45.30:1.14: Ime kho Uttiya pañcakāmaguṇā vuttā mayā || || 6.
sn45.30:1.15: Imesaṃ kho Uttiya pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānam pahānāya ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo || ||
sn45.30:1.18: Imesaṃ kho Uttiya pañcannaṃ kāmaguṇānam pahānāya ayam ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo bhāvetabbo ti || ||
